clientSettingsTab.loadingMessage.updatin: Updating Agent Network focused view setting...
clientSettingsTab.text.configureHowNetBi: Configure how NetBird clients receive update notifications. When enabled, users will be prompted to install the selected version. This requires at least NetBird
clientSettingsTab.helpText.whenEnabledUp: When enabled, updates are installed automatically in the background without user interaction.
clientSettingsTab.text.enablingAutomatic: Enabling automatic updates will restart the NetBird client during updates, which can temporarily disrupt active connections. Use with caution in production environments.
clientSettingsTab.text.allowPeersToExpos: Allow peers to expose local services through the NetBird reverse proxy using the CLI.
clientSettingsTab.helpText.whenEnabledPe: When enabled, peers can expose local HTTP services accessible via a public URL.
clientSettingsTab.text.selectWhichPeerGr: Select which peer groups are allowed to expose services. At least one group is required.
clientSettingsTab.text.insteadOfMaintain: Instead of maintaining always-on connections, NetBird activates them on-demand based on activity or signaling. This requires NetBird client v0.50.1 or higher.
clientSettingsTab.text.allowToEstablishC: Allow to establish connections between peers only when required. Changes will take effect after restarting the clients.
clientSettingsTab.text.byDefaultAPeerReg: By default, a peer registering or being renamed with a hostname that is already in use receives an IP-based suffix on its DNS label.
clientSettingsTab.helpText.whenEnabledRe: When enabled, registering or renaming a peer to a hostname that is already in use fails instead of receiving a suffix. This applies to ephemeral peers as well.
clientSettingsTab.text.focusTheDashboard: Focus the dashboard on the Agent Network surface and hide sections that are not relevant for it, such as Networks, DNS and Reverse Proxy.
clientSettingsTab.helpText.whenEnabledTh: When enabled, the dashboard shows only the Agent Network related sections. Disable it to bring back the full dashboard.
